title: Departure nudge: per row, held?
text: T-3742 design (notes/T-3742.md): an Offset per weekday schedule row in the schedule window, in 1 min steps (15 s with Shift, 10 min with Ctrl), held so the game stops re-timing that row; both directions shift together so turnarounds are kept, and a line timed with a faster partner shifts the partner by the same seconds. Riders and money barely move; a nudge only lasts between lines on matching headways. About 5-7 h, after track stage 1 lands. Alternatives: one offset per line (4-6 h) or wait for Exact mode (24-34 h). Build per row? I'd say yes. Draft strings: column 'Offset', '1 min earlier' / '1 min later', 'Half a headway at most', 'Follows weekdays'.

title: Express vs local: soft rule prototype?
text: T-4008 measured it: income groups don't even out express and local, since both lines charge the same fare and a rider who values time more counts the wait and the ride more by the same factor. New York today: 55.7% take the express where both serve a pair directly, and 37% of those trips go nearly all one way. With 2 or 3 groups: unchanged, for +20-40% calculating time and +34-67 MB. What does even them out: a soft rule (a slower train that comes first is sometimes taken) gives about 48% express and about 5% all-one-way on direct pairs, with no extra search; a small lie, since riders move while the costs shown stay today's. Drop income groups for this, and prototype the soft rule with crowding (about 2-3 h)? I'd say yes to both.
